# Orvio 0.30

- Films and episodes on phones: double tap the right side of the screen to jump 30 seconds forward, the left side to jump 30 seconds back.
- Picture-in-Picture shows only Android's own controls; the second, unusable pause button is gone.
- Settings → Sound: Preview sound now always plays (at media volume). When Android's touch sounds are off, the page says so, since interface sounds stay quiet without them.
